answer: Locks are written down in jetty, expire in gale, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 189 aliases therefore needs 137 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2628 identities would post 3342 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
